description: Stack the current coalesced-staging n=32/n=64/n=128 winner with the refined reusable compact-panel CuTe path. Preserve direct cuSOLVER through n=4096 and CuTe from n=8192, reconcile extension caching and fast-math flags, validate all paths, and tune merged dispatch/state so the small-cell gains and large conversion gains coexist.

Merged the coalesced register-resident n32/n64/n128 winner with the reusable eight-value compact FP16 panel converter, in-place cuBLAS TRSM, and two-CTA SM100 CuTe triangular RankK path. Direct BF16x9 cuSOLVER remains selected through n4096 and CuTe at batch-one n8192+. Build, all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. Small cells measured 17.164/20.972/57.410 us and large CuTe cells 4954.726/15505.739/56002.837 us; full geomean reached 1074.370 us versus 1086.905/1129.003 us for the parents.

Separated mixed/CuTe state from direct cuSOLVER state: n8192+ and high-batch mixed shapes no longer allocate unused info, solver workspace, or pointer tensors, while all dispatch thresholds and kernels remain unchanged. Build, official validation, fresh-seed guard, and full benchmark passed. Small cells were 17.212/21.040/57.545 us, CuTe cells 4952.128/15527.616/56295.466 us, and full geomean measured 1073.144 us versus 1074.370 us for the exact merge.

For batch-one CuTe shapes, replaced the full output copy plus final in-place tril sweep with ATen lower-only seeding and direct return; high-batch mixed and direct paths remain unchanged. Build, official validation, fresh-seed guard, and full benchmark passed. CuTe cells improved from 4952.128/15527.616/56295.466 to 4915.829/15371.563/55281.526 us, while unrelated direct/high-batch cells sampled slower and full geomean measured 1076.752 us versus 1073.144 us.

Added a shape-scoped column-major 4096-square factor buffer and dedicated info scalar for batch-one CuTe panels, eliminating repeated cholesky_ex output allocations while retaining lower-only seeding and mixed/direct state separation. Build, official validation, and fresh-seed guard passed. The first benchmark entered uniform low-clock mode at 1766.799 us; a full repeat on identical code measured normal small cells 17.175/20.992/57.576 us, CuTe cells 4918.770/15317.248/54755.914 us, and a new 1071.488 us geomean versus 1073.144 us for state pruning alone.

Zero-initialized each cached batch-one CuTe output once, then replaced generic tril_out seeding with a row-persistent float4 CUDA kernel that reads and writes only the logical lower triangle on repeated calls. Build, all official tests, fresh-seed guard, and full benchmark passed. Small cells stayed 17.175/20.990/57.481 us; CuTe cells improved to 4772.662/14791.802/53321.911 us from the reusable-factor trial's 4918.770/15317.248/54755.914 us, and full geomean reached 1068.764 us versus 1071.488 us.

Replaced each generic 4096-square factor copy with a shared-memory tiled transpose that wrote only logical lower tiles. Build and all official validation/fresh-seed guards passed, and benchmark shapes through n4096 remained correct, but n8192/16384/32768 failed reconstruction (0.0227/0.0601/0.0909 residual): CuTe schedules lower 256x256 tiles yet densely writes each diagonal tile, so their upper-within-tile entries require explicit clearing.

Fixed the tiled factor-copy design by zeroing the full logical upper half of each 4096 diagonal block while reading factor data only for lower tiles. The shared-memory transpose keeps lower factor reads and output writes coalesced and preserves CuTe diagonal-tile clearing. Build, official validation, fresh-seed guard, and every benchmark shape passed. Small cells were 17.122/20.931/57.434 us; CuTe cells improved from 4772.662/14791.802/53321.911 to 4660.722/14559.581/52708.096 us, and full geomean reached 1058.933 us versus 1068.764 us.

Widened the coalesced factor transpose/upper-clear tile from 32x32 to 64x64, reducing its grid from 16384 to 4096 CTAs. Build, official validation, fresh-seed guard, and full benchmark passed. CuTe cells measured 4663.105/14581.690/52463.541 us versus 4660.722/14559.581/52708.096 us at tile32: n32768 improved 0.46% while n8192/n16384 rose 0.05/0.15%. Full geomean measured 1060.915 us versus 1058.933 us amid unrelated-cell variation.

Restored the selected 32x32 factor-copy tile and packed each eight-value compact-panel conversion into one aligned uint4 store instead of four half2 stores. Build, official validation, fresh-seed guard, and full benchmark passed, but CuTe cells regressed from 4660.722/14559.581/52708.096 to 4685.007/14611.735/52904.556 us. Full geomean measured 1064.431 us versus 1058.933 us for separate half2 stores.

Restored the selected 32x32 lower-read/full-clear factor copy with separate half2 compact-panel stores and ran a final comparator. Build, all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. Cells measured 17.145/20.904/57.401 us for n32/64/128 and 4666.547/14570.758/52536.928 us for n8192/16384/32768; full geomean remeasured 1059.677 us, within 0.07% of the same selected stack's 1058.933 us best sample.

Combined the factor-copy tile sweep by selecting tile32 at n8192/n16384 and tile64 at n32768. Build, official validation, fresh-seed guard, and full benchmark passed, but the expected n32768 crossover did not repeat: cells measured 4689.650/14619.703/52552.930 us and aggregate 1067.102 us, versus 4666.547/14570.758/52536.928 us and 1059.677 us for uniform tile32 in the immediately prior comparator.

Best commit f041bc224f6b6d4caf9123bcd2c8148863f299a0 measured 1058.933 us, with equivalent selected commit e7202d2998665a018d05195a47df576d86f011f2 remeasuring 1059.677 us. The exact parent merge scored 1074.370; mixed-state pruning 1073.144; lower-only output seeding plus reusable factors 1071.488; cached vector lower seeding 1068.764; and the 32x32 lower-read/full-upper-clear factor transpose reached 1058.933. One lower-only factor copy failed large-shape correctness and was fixed. Tile64 scored 1060.915, packed uint4 conversion 1064.431, and size-dispatched tiles 1067.102. Every succeeded design passed all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes; final profiling was waived by the Modal-only run contract. Keep this line moving with a single current-stream kernel that combines factor output copy and compact-panel conversion after TRSM, a structured conversion-grid cap sweep around 4096 CTAs, or a CuTe/TMA FP32-to-FP16 load transform that removes the standalone compact conversion.
